notes.claim: A balanced object has total clockwise moment about a pivot equal to total anticlockwise moment about that pivot.
A moment of a force is the force multiplied by the distance, measured at right angles to the direction of the force.
The distance in a moment is measured from the pivot, at a right angle to the line of action of the force.
For a balanced object, moments may be taken about the pivot or any other point, but it must be the same point for every force.
